verifications.claim: Samsung is discontinuing its native Samsung Messages app in July 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The Samsung Messages application will be discontinued in July 2026." (R1); "Samsung Messages will be discontinued in July 2026" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state discontinuation of Samsung Messages in July 2026.

verifications.claim: Samsung is shifting entirely to Google Messages as the default RCS messaging app on Galaxy devices.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Upgrade to Google Messages as your default messaging app today" (R1); "The default messaging app will be Google Messages" (R2); promotes RCS features in Google Messages (R1, R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm transition to Google Messages as default app with RCS support across Galaxy devices.

verifications.claim: Samsung Messages will no longer be pre-installed on new devices like the Galaxy S26.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Owners of the Galaxy S26 and newer devices cannot download the Samsung Messages app from the Galaxy Store." (R1); "Samsung stopped allowing Samsung Messages to be downloaded on their newer Galaxy phones, like the Samsung Galaxy S26 series." (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Sources indicate Samsung Messages is unavailable (cannot download) on new devices like Galaxy S26, implying not pre-installed, but do not explicitly mention pre-installation.

verifications.claim: Samsung Messages will no longer be available on new devices like the Galaxy S26.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Owners of the Galaxy S26 and newer devices cannot download the Samsung Messages app from the Galaxy Store." (R1); "Samsung Messages will not be available for download on Galaxy S26 or new devices" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state Samsung Messages cannot be downloaded or is unavailable on new devices like Galaxy S26.

verifications.claim: Samsung Messages will cease to function by July 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "sending messages via Samsung Messages on your phone will no longer be possible" (R1); "the messaging app will no longer be functional on your Samsung phone" (R2); "you won’t be able to send any messages via Samsung’s app" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state Samsung Messages will no longer function for sending/receiving after July 2026 (except emergencies).

verifications.claim: Google Messages will become the default SMS app.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Upgrade to Google Messages as your default messaging app" (R1); "Google Messages will be the default messaging app on Samsung phones" (R2); "Set default SMS app” (R1, R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Google Messages is to become or is the default SMS/messaging app on Samsung devices.
